title: Lumen Lattice
archiveRole: First Puzzle Logic Hall observation sample
description: Lumen Lattice: Prism Archive is a PC-first constraint logic puzzle. Each press sends light through a fixed pattern (pulse, beam, or split) that flips a set of prisms. Every lattice is generated by reverse-scrambling a solved board, so each puzzle is guaranteed solvable, with tracked-parity hint and autoSolve.

deviceSupport.mobileNotes: PC-first benchmark tuned for keyboard and mouse at 1440x900 and 1920x1080. Mobile is baseline playable: the square board scales to width, prisms are tap targets, and the tools stay reachable, but larger lattices read more comfortably on desktop. Checked in local browser device-emulation viewports only; no physical handset QA is claimed.

keyboard: WASD or Arrow keys to move the cursor
Space or Enter to press the cursor prism
P to pause / open the menu
pointer: Click a prism to apply the active rule
touch: Tap a prism to apply the active rule
